user.title: Set up a BRU tea maker
user.description: Put the tea maker in **pairing mode**, then select it below.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description:
Do you want to set up **{name}**?

Put the tea maker in **pairing mode** before you continue.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description:
Home Assistant has no working pairing with **{name}**.

Put the tea maker in **pairing mode** before you continue.

confirm_code.title: Confirm the pairing code
confirm_code.description:
The tea maker should now be showing this code:

## {code}

1. Check that the code on the tea maker matches.
2. Accept it **on the tea maker's screen**.
3. Press **Submit** here.

progress.pairing:
Connecting to **{name}**…

If a 6-digit code appears on the tea maker's screen, accept it there.
progress.waiting_for_device: Waiting for the code to be accepted on **{name}**…

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured BRU tea makers found.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup of this tea maker is already in progress.
abort.cannot_connect: The tea maker is not in Bluetooth range of Home Assistant.
abort.pairing_failed:
Pairing failed.

Make sure the tea maker is in **pairing mode** and that the code is accepted on its screen. After a failed attempt the tea maker refuses new ones for about five minutes.
abort.reauth_successful: The tea maker is paired again.
